source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The overflow path calls pending callbacks with a plain result object carrying resultCode -1. The inspected search receiver switches on response constructor names and the SASL receiver handles only in-progress or success codes, so neither converts that object into a terminal listener notification. The overflow path closes the socket without calling its explicit onError path, while onClose only logs. This limits the comment's claim that higher layers cannot hang; it is a static notification concern, not an observed hang, exploit or cure.
title: The LDAP overflow callback object does not match the search and SASL terminal receivers
